review_question: Is this Ansible artifact excessively large and in need of decomposition?
source_context:
1: ---
     2: # Reconcile the operator account's group membership on EVERY converge.
     3: #
     4: # users.yml is seeded create-if-absent (the argon2 hash is salted, so
     5: # re-rendering it would rotate the password on every run). That is correct for
     6: # the credential and wrong for group membership: a group added to the template
     7: # alone reaches a fresh deployment only, and on an existing one the converge
     8: # reports changed=0 while the group the operator needs is simply absent. Adding
     9: # `terrakube-admins` to the template was exactly that — a change that read as
    10: # applied and granted nothing.
    11: #
    12: # So membership is merged into the live file here instead. Additive by design:
    13: # groups present on the guest but not in authelia_admin_groups are left alone,
    14: # because the portal and any hand-grant are also writers of this file. Nothing
    15: # but the groups list is rewritten, and the task is a no-op once converged.
    16: 
    17: - name: Read the live users database
    18:   ansible.builtin.slurp:
    19:     src: "{{ authelia_users_file }}"
    20:   register: authelia_users_raw
    21:   no_log: true
    22: 
    23: - name: Resolve the operator's current and required groups
    24:   ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    25:     # `| default([], true)` on the groups read: a user block with `groups:` and
    26:     # nothing under it parses as null, not as an empty list, and union() on null
    27:     # raises rather than returning the required set.
    28:     authelia_admin_groups_current: >-
    29:       {{ ((authelia_users_raw.content | b64decode | from_yaml).users[authelia_admin_user].groups
    30:           | default([], true)) }}
    31:   no_log: true
    32: 
    33: - name: Fail when Terrakube SSO is enabled but its admin group did not resolve
    34:   ansible.builtin.assert:
    35:     that:
    36:       - authelia_terrakube_admin_group | length > 0
    37:     fail_msg: >-
    38:       authelia_terrakube_sso_enabled is true but DEX_GITHUB_ORG / DEX_GITHUB_TEAM
    39:       are not both set in the converge environment, so the org-qualified Terrakube
    40:       admin group could not be composed. Authelia would emit no Terrakube group at
    41:       all and the operator would authenticate to Terrakube with no rights. Set both
    42:       (they are the same two values the Terrakube compose file composes
    43:       TERRAKUBE_ADMIN_GROUP from) or leave authelia_terrakube_sso_enabled false.
    44:     success_msg: "Terrakube admin group resolved."
    45:   when: authelia_terrakube_sso_enabled | bool
    46: 
    47: - name: Grant the operator any required group it is missing
    48:   ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    49:     authelia_admin_groups_merged: >-
    50:       {{ authelia_admin_groups_current | union(authelia_admin_groups) }}
    51:   no_log: true
    52: 
    53: - name: Update the operator's group membership
    54:   when: authelia_admin_groups_merged | symmetric_difference(authelia_admin_groups_current) | length > 0
    55:   # lineinfile is deliberately not used: the groups list is multi-line, and a
    56:   # regex edit of a YAML sequence is how these files get corrupted. The whole
    57:   # document is re-emitted from the parsed structure with only the groups key
    58:   # replaced, so the password hash is carried through verbatim rather than
    59:   # re-generated.
    60:   ansible.builtin.copy:
    61:     content: >-
    62:       {{ (authelia_users_raw.content | b64decode | from_yaml)
    63:          | combine({'users': {authelia_admin_user: {'groups': authelia_admin_groups_merged}}},
    64:                    recursive=True)
    65:          | to_nice_yaml(indent=2) }}
    66:     dest: "{{ authelia_users_file }}"
    67:     owner: "{{ authelia_users_file_owner }}"
    68:     group: "{{ authelia_group }}"
    69:     mode: "0640"
    70:   no_log: true
    71:   notify: Restart authelia
